files.types/index.d.ts:
export type RunState = 'halted' | 'ready' | 'running'

export type Lease = { session_id: string; at: string }

/** One run as `statusline_cli.php --json` prints it. */
export type Row = {
  issue: number | null
  branch: string
  step: string
  status: string
  state: RunState
  age: string
  stale: boolean
  pr: number | null
  issueUrl: string | null
  prUrl: string | null
  detail: string
  proof: string | null
  manifest: string
  worktree: string
  lease: Lease | null
}

export type Band = { repo: string | null; primary: string | null; runs: Row[]; hidden: number }

export type ProofGroup = 'needs-you' | 'running' | 'merged'
export type ProofStatus = 'halted' | 'ready' | 'running' | 'merged'
export type ProofScope = 'all' | 'here'

/** One run as `proof_cli.php list` prints it (proof-store.md §The pane). */
export type ProofRun = {
  key: string
  group: ProofGroup
  status: ProofStatus
  reason: string
  repo: string
  nameWithOwner: string | null
  title: string
  pr: number | null
  issue: number | null
  branch: string | null
  base: string | null
  worktree: string | null
  summary: string | null
  tests: string | null
  questions: { count: number; first: string[] }
  seen: number | null
  since: string | null
  age: string | null
  page: string
  prUrl: string | null
  filesUrl: string | null
  issueUrl: string | null
  manifest: string | null
  lease: Lease | null
  primary: string | null
  step: string | null
}

export type ProofList = { runs: ProofRun[] }

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'run-band': {
      band: Band | null
      busy: string[]
      proofs: ProofList | null
      selected: string | null
      scope: ProofScope
      seen: Record<string, number>
    }
  }
}
